state.project: Bainbridge Transmission: East River Road, East Bainbridge
state.description: This project will construct a new 115kV breaker and a half substation a mile north of the East Bainbridge substation. East Bainbridge will be simplified to a 115kV straight bus with two transmission lines for service to load, a generation interconnection point and a capacitor bank.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
